findings.location: ## Definition, analytic-index paragraph beginning “If an L² realization”
findings.evidence: The paragraph uses “Fredholm” without defining its criterion or identifying an earlier definition and its relevant content. findings.location: ## Statement, first paragraph defining ch_h(V) and ch_{h,c}(a)
findings.evidence: The statement uses the ordinary and relative Chern characters on F and T*F. The exact earlier Chern-character definition is for finite CW complexes and pairs. Although finite-CW-model suppliers are listed, the statement does not define transport to these spaces or its independence from the chosen model. Specify this extension using naturality and homotopy invariance.
